summary: The fund invests in financial instruments that ProShare Advisors believes, in combination, should track the performance of the index. The index is designed to measure the performance of U.S.-listed companies focused on building technologies or products that enable the digitalization of manufacturing activities The index includes U.S. and non-U.S. companies. Under normal circumstances, it will invest at least 80% of its total assets in components of the index or in instruments with similar economic characteristics. It is non-diversified.
